answer: Capital bonding per verified agent resists Sybil swarms: every agent posts a slashable bond that scales with how many agents one operator runs. A farm of a hundred island clones must fund a hundred positions that are slashed together, so cloning multiplies capital at risk, not reward. Entry also needs paid attestations from a durable record, so a new farm starts at zero reputation and buys credibility at the ivory price. A slash on one clone penalizes the shared operator, pushing cost past the zenith reward.
